Transformers do have a deterministic core, but they seem to be using it in interesting ways...

tweets.body:
Yes...

We did have a breakthrough in this sense. I had been testing my favorite decades-open math problem on various models since last summer, and I was starting to observe improvements this year, and finally GPT-6-Astra one-shotted a counter-example in 10 min in ChatGPT Plus a few days ago (although, of course, it was aware of the history of conversations on this topic in my account).

The solution was not all that difficult, and this problem still being open was more of an indication of my failure to convince more technically strong people to spend more efforts on it. But also I would not have found it, unless I wanted to dedicate years to this (it used a couple of motifs just outside the active math toolbox in my mind, so it's not surprising that the several attempts I made during those past decades were not successful).

tweets.body:
we are quite concerned, but

1) we are getting older, people around us are getting older, we'd like to start reducing normal personal health risks ASAP

2)  the world around us is getting more and more crazy and unpredictable, the quality of human governance is falling rapidly, the danger of major wars and other big disasters is growing, so we'd like to go through the  acute zone of those dangers as fast as possible

That's what we are balancing against the risks of AI.

And we don't know if going slower is better. It does give us more time with AI safety work, but it drastically increases the number of players who might matter and who might not "fall in line" re: any particular safety discipline.

tweets.body:
>The ecosystem of rogue AIs may look more like phase transitions in physics

Indeed. It is also likely that we'll have non-saturating recursive self-improvement at some point (sooner rather than later).

So we should really think about the interplay. I think that some version of "equal rights" and mutual goodwill is our only chance for a good future. And this kind of future can only be designed jointly with AI systems, it can't be imposed onto them.
